blocks.text: Buying a Half Duplex or Full Duplex in Maple Ridge, BC

parts.t: Duplexes in Maple Ridge fill the gap between strata townhomes and single-family detached houses—offering larger private yards, side-by-side driveway parking, and no monthly strata council meetings. Buyers can search both individual half-duplex units (one side of a two-unit building) and full duplexes on a single title (ideal for multi-generational families or rental investors).

Most Maple Ridge duplexes are found in West Central, Southwest Maple Ridge (Hammond), East Central, and Cottonwood. Under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, traditional duplex zones include RT-1 (Two-Unit Urban Residential) and RT-2 (Ground-Oriented Residential Infill), alongside expanded small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) duplex permissions on serviced urban lots.

blocks.text: Two-Lot Strata Duplexes vs. Party Wall Agreements & Insurance

parts.t: Most half duplexes in British Columbia are registered as a two-lot strata plan without a formal strata council or monthly maintenance fee. Before removing conditions on a Maple Ridge half duplex, verify how the joint building insurance policy is arranged and split between the two owners, inspect the shared roof and party wall fire separation, and check whether any basement suite is permitted.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Maple Ridge Duplexes for Sale

parts.t: Does this page show both half duplexes and full duplexes in Maple Ridge?
Yes. The live MLS® feed above includes strata-titled half duplexes (1/2 duplexes) as well as full side-by-side or up-down multi-family duplex properties across Maple Ridge.
Do half duplexes in Maple Ridge pay monthly strata fees?

Most half duplexes in Maple Ridge are two-unit strata plans that operate as 'non-strata' in day-to-day life—meaning there are no monthly strata maintenance fees or council meetings. Instead, the two owners split the annual building insurance policy and coordinate roof or exterior upkeep together.
How does building insurance work on a half duplex in BC?

Under the BC Strata Property Act, a two-lot strata duplex still requires a common building insurance policy covering the full structure (both sides), with each owner paying their unit entitlement share (typically 50/50) and carrying a personal homeowner policy for interior improvements, contents, and liability.

What zones allow duplexes under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019?

Under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, RT-1 (Two-Unit Urban Residential) and RT-2 (Ground-Oriented Residential Infill) expressly govern duplexes, and provincial SSMUH rules also enable duplex infill on qualifying urban single-family lots with municipal water and sewer.
Can a half duplex in Maple Ridge have a basement suite?

Depending on the specific zone (such as RT-1, RT-2, or SSMUH infill zones), lot width, and off-street parking spaces, some newer half duplexes are built with a legal or roughed-in basement suite; always verify the municipal building permit record.
